title: Trump: DOJ releases some Epstein files with heavy redactions, hundreds of thousands of files missing
description_short: Trump: DOJ releases some Epstein files with heavy redactions, hundreds of thousands of files missing
description_medium: The Justice Department released Jeffrey Epstein-related records on December 19, 2025. Reports described extensive redactions and estimated that hundreds of thousands of files were missing, but no release inventory or calculation method accompanies that figure. The scale of the omission and the legal basis for withholding records remain unclear.

notes: The linked page returns an anti-bot challenge. To assess the release, the record inventory, the method behind the estimate of hundreds of thousands of missing files, and the legal basis for redactions are needed. The cited description does not supply those details.
